newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 8.47 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 50 bln dong T-notes, rate 8.47 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 50 billion dong ($4.54 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 8.47 percent to domestic and foreign institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on August 28, the central bank issued 100 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 8.60 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is September 13 and maturity will be September 13, 1997.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) 24.0 billion
Vietnam General Insurance Company (Bao Viet) 20.0 billion
